pages.text: Ornate hookahs are two-block-tall decorative versions of the hookah. They use the same HookahEntity inventory, fuel rules, shisha rules, water requirement, and hose interaction as the basic hookah.

The basic single-block Hookah has an extra cosmetic feature: right-click it with any Dye to change its color, or with a Glow Ink Sac to enable its glowing state. Those cosmetic state controls belong to the basic Hookah block, not the ornate two-block variants.
pages.title: Basic Hookah Decoration
